lyrics:
[Intro: stomps and claps, percussive acoustic guitar, low hum]

[Verse 1: tumbling triplet rhythm, gritty and low]
I was a quiet kid with thunder in my chest
Wrote it on the inside, never handed in the test
Learned to smile at everything that hollowed me out
Carried other people's weather till I couldn't do without

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, voice rising]
I was cracked, I was cornered, I was coming apart
Every hit was a hammer on the wall of my heart

[Chorus: one shouted word, then huge distorted drums]
Break!
I was nothing till I shattered
Break!
Every crack is where the light got in
I was built by the break
The fall, the ache
Oh, let the hard days come
I was built by the break

[Verse 2: tumbling triplet rhythm, more force]
I was choking in the middle of a room that knew my name
Pulling splinters out of trophies, never happy that I came
Had a mirror I avoided, had a number I'd not call
Had a ceiling I was holding, and I let the ceiling fall

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, voice rising]
I was cracked, I was cornered, I was coming apart
Every hit was a hammer on the wall of my heart

[Chorus: one shouted word, then huge distorted drums]
Break!
I was nothing till I shattered
Break!
Every crack is where the light got in
I was built by the break
The fall, the ache
Oh, let the hard days come
I was built by the break

[Bridge: everything drops, quiet voice and one guitar]
And if you're in the middle of it
I won't say it's fine
I'll only say I've been there
And I came out mine

[Final Chorus: loudest, gang vocals, stomps on every beat]
Break!
I was nothing till I shattered
Break!
Every crack is where the light got in
I was built by the break
The fall, the ache
Oh, let the hard days come
I was built by the break

[Outro: stomps and claps alone, one last shout]
Break!
